Read the file COPYING.GPLv2 for the full text of the GPL.

The MemoChat Linux client build links FFmpeg via Qt Multimedia's bundled
FFmpeg plugin (libffmpegmediaplugin.so). Only LGPL-licensed codecs are
enabled; no GPL-only or proprietary codec is activated. The shared library
is distributed unmodified from the Qt installation.

Source code for the FFmpeg version shipped with Qt 6 is available at:
  https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtwebengine-chromium.git/
and via Qt's Open Source compliance pages at:
  https://www.qt.io/qt-in-use/open-source-compliance

FFmpeg project home: https://ffmpeg.org/
